Cary Collection of Playing Cards (Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library)
BEIN PLAYING CARDS GEN 1316: Cary's original reference number on case: "F-223". Ms. annotation on case in Melbert B. Cary's hand: "1/1/38 Gift Marteau". From the Cary Collection of Playing Cards.
Composition of deck: 78 (A, K, Q, C, J, 10-2, trumps I-XXI, Fool).
Single figure trumps: B. P. GRIMAUD. PARIS; VII: S.M.
Card backs: swirls and dots, green and light green.
Issued in box, brown: [label] B. P. GRIMAUD / ANCIEN TAROT / DE MARSEILLE / PARIS.
78 cards : 119 x 62 mm, in box 128 x 70 x 42 mm
